message.content:
I don’t have real‑time access to live air‑quality feeds, so I can’t tell you the exact AQI for Los Angeles at this moment.  For the most up‑to‑date information you can check one of the following:

| Source | What it offers | How to use |
|--------|----------------|------------|
| **AirNow** (EPA) | Current AQI, forecast, and health advisories for U.S. cities | Go to https://www.airnow.gov/, enter “Los Angeles” or your ZIP code. |
| **AQICN** (World Air Quality Index) | Global real‑time AQI, maps, and historical data | Visit https://aqicn.org/, search for “Los Angeles”. |
| **Local news sites** (e.g., LA Times, KABC) | Often publish daily air‑quality summaries | Search “Los Angeles air quality” on their websites. |
| **Mobile apps** (e.g., Plume Labs, BreezoMeter) | Push notifications for AQI changes | Download the app, enable location services. |

If you’re looking for a quick snapshot, you can also use a voice assistant (Google Assistant, Siri, Alexa) and ask “What’s the air quality in Los Angeles?” They usually pull the latest data from AirNow or a similar service.
